newsitem.title: FRANCE: Boissonat says franc probably undervalued vs mark.
newsitem.headline: Boissonat says franc probably undervalued vs mark.

text.p: Bank of France monetary policy council member Jean Boissonnat said on Thursday that the franc was probably slightly undervalued against the mark.
"The franc is in an excellent competitive situation copared to the mark. We are probably even slightly undervalued compared to the mark," he told French radio.

Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet has said repeatedly that he believes the correct level for the franc is its European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) central rate of 3.35 per mark, compared to 3.3890 per mark late on Thursday.
